purpose: California 2024 data coverage and administration-context source inventory for Civic Result Maps. This inventory documents source paths and caveats; it does not load row-level audit, CVR, incident, correction, recount, litigation, custody, or tabulator-log records.

loadedArtifacts.caveat: Registered Voters totals are based on the 15-day Report of Registration and do not include voters registered after the 15-day close; Same Day Voter Registration may occur later through Election Day.

loadedArtifacts.caveat: Equipment rows are jurisdiction-level administration context only; they are not vote, turnout, audit, incident, or proof-of-uniformity rows.

loadedArtifacts.caveat: SWDB is valid for future precinct/local collection, but active CA production rows continue to use official Secretary of State Statement of Vote county artifacts.

sourceFindings.finding: The SOS Statement of Vote voter participation table replaces the prior EAC fallback for active CA turnout rows at county grain.

California SOS election-security guidance states that election officials conduct a manual audit of a random 1% of ballots. County-specific 2024 audit selections, samples, discrepancy records, and outcomes are not normalized in this pass.
sourceFindings.neededArtifact: Official county or SOS 2024 post-election audit selection and outcome records.

sourceFindings.finding: The SOS recount page provides recount guidance and historical recount links, but no normalized 2024 President or U.S. Senate recount rows are loaded.
sourceFindings.neededArtifact: Official SOS, court, or county recount/election-contest records if any relevant 2024 rows exist.

sourceFindings.finding: No statewide 2024 California CVR package or county-by-county CVR availability statement is loaded. Use SOS or county public-records channels and ballot-secrecy/redaction review before normalization.

No normalized 2024 incident, correction, litigation, custody, L&A, or tabulator-log rows are loaded. Official SOS, court, and county records remain required before adding row-level administration context.

The 2024 Statement of Vote includes an official voting-systems-by-county PDF lead. Current normalized equipment context remains the existing Verified Voting county package until the SOS PDF is normalized and reconciled.

Current CA review rows are county-level President-versus-U.S. Senate full-term comparisons. Precinct, city, or other local reporting-unit President plus same-grain comparison rows were not loaded in this pass.

The submitted California Statewide Database source is a valid precinct/local result and geography source lead, but it remains supplemental. The active CA package should keep California SOS Statement of Vote sources authoritative for certified county results, county U.S. Senate comparison rows, turnout, and historical baselines.
caveats: SWDB's 2024 General page notes that Madera County posted files do not match certified vote counts and are partial pending required county data.
SWDB notes small precinct privacy masking and temporary 2024 file artifacts.
No SWDB vote rows are downloaded or normalized in the current CA ETL.

displayCaveats: County-level CA review rows are advisory comparison context, not precinct scatter plots or findings.
The active CA turnout package uses SOS total voters and 15-day registered-voter denominators; presidential contest votes reconcile separately to the President by County workbook.
County geometry is loaded for map joins; precinct boundary geometry is not loaded.
SWDB is retained as a supplemental precinct/local and geography lead only; CA SOS Statement of Vote remains authoritative until any SWDB parser reconciles to certified totals.
Audit, CVR, incident, correction, recount, litigation, custody, and tabulator-log paths are source leads only until official row-level artifacts are collected and normalized.
